# Varner Equipment — Dealership Information & AI Agent Manifest

> Varner Equipment is a premier family-owned agricultural, commercial tractor, and trailer dealership located in Delta, Colorado (1375 US-50, Delta, CO 81416). Serving Western Colorado including Delta, Montrose, Grand Junction, Mesa County, and Gunnison.
